text: The successful candidate will have full P&L accountability of $150M USD for the APAC business.
Requires a leader who has managed a commercial P&L of over €10M in the logistics sector.
Responsible for managing an annual operational budget of $5,000,000 across multiple sites.
Will oversee budget allocation and budget ownership of £2M for capital expenditures.
Must be comfortable carrying a sales quota and revenue target of $20M annually.
Responsible for delivering top-line growth and revenue accountability of $50M.
Direct accountability for operational margin improvement and EBITDA targets of $2M.
Responsible for optimizing costs to meet annual EBITDA goals.
Will have commercial accountability for vendor negotiations and contract signing.
Responsible for commercial growth strategy, pricing models, and gross margin optimization.
Collaborate closely with the budget owner to support budget planning processes.
Position reports to the Chief Operating Officer and manages a team of 15 members.
Will support the sales enablement team with client presentations and material preparation.
Responsible for customer success, retention campaigns, and net promoter score improvements.
Must understand P&L structures and financial statements in order to analyze report metrics.
Assisting with the budget planning and presenting recommendations to function leads.
Requires experience analyzing revenue streams and pricing structures for enterprise accounts.
Work closely with finance leads to provide inputs for the annual budget.
Responsible for executing marketing campaigns within the allocated media budget.
Position requires knowledge of EBITDA calculations and SaaS metrics.
